rounds.text: Kajaria Ceramics demonstrates superior capital efficiency and balance sheet strength, delivering an ROCE of 23.3% [E12] against a sector benchmark of 9.66% [E10] and an ROA of 13.59% versus the sector benchmark of 2.85% [E8], while remaining almost debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.07x [E38, E60]. This operational quality is backed by cash flow generation, including Rs 664 Cr in operating cash flow [E35], Rs 563 Cr in free cash flow [E36], and a strong cash conversion ratio of 1.36x [E34]. Profit momentum is accelerating, highlighted by trailing-twelve-month profit growth of 64% [E21] and YoY net profit growth of 55% [E66], with quarterly operating margins expanding to 20% in June 2026 [E31]. Underlying fundamentals are outpacing share price performance [E57, E58], further reinforced by a strong sector tailwind in Consumer Durables [E72, E73] and a relative-strength rating of 89 [E52]. Conceded: The stock commands a premium valuation with a P/E of 34.2 [E1] against the sector benchmark of 28.09x [E6], and a DCF analysis implies a margin of safety of -46.9% [E47, E69]. However, a decade-long median ROE of 17% [E26] alongside a healthy dividend payout ratio of 46.6% [E61] demonstrates that high return metrics and cash generation fully underpin the core business.
